result: Adam can fail to converge for a fixed β2 because its second moment contains the current gradient. ADOPT normalizes each fresh gradient by the previous second moment and applies momentum after normalizing, which gives the optimal O(1/√T) rate for any β2, assuming only a bounded second moment of the gradients.
result_plain: Normalize by the previous second moment, then momentum: optimal O(1/√T) for any β2.
